BitoPro Market Intel Skill 1.4.0

- Added BitoPro-relevant cryptocurrency news aggregation (Tool 8): collects news from 6 sources (3 zh-tw + 3 English auto-translated to 繁中) and filters to BitoPro-listed coins.
- Updated description and documentation to reflect new news aggregation feature.
- Included unofficial Google Translate integration for automatic translation of English news to 繁中.
- Added new file: references/news-categories.md for news filtering and categories.
- No API or data source changes for existing market intel features.

## v1.0.1 Changelog

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Skill description and documentation updated only; no code or tool changes.
- Maintains strict focus on BitoPro-listed spot coins for market intelligence and macro indicators.

**Initial release of bitopro-market-intel skill, focused on market intelligence for BitoPro-listed spot coins.**

- Provides crypto market data, trends, and rankings strictly for coins listed on BitoPro's spot market.
- Integrates free, public sources (CoinGecko, CoinPaprika, BitoPro, Alternative.me) with no API keys required.
- Supports queries for Fear & Greed index, coin price/rankings, BTC/ETH dominance, institutional BTC/ETH holdings, and trending coins—filtered to BitoPro-listed assets only.
- Excludes non-BitoPro coins, sector/category overviews, and derivatives by design.
- Includes refresh instructions for BitoPro coin lists to ensure up-to-date symbol mapping.
